name: Static / Jam Burst / local-mesh disruption packet

description.value:
One round of silence on an enemy device - the tactical EW debuff.

  • Item Tier: T3
  • Availability: 3
  • Cost: ¥2,000
  • Profile: Consumable program-mod (one use, occupies 1 deck slot until fired). Effect: Suppresses one enemy device (smartgun link, camera, comm, hostile drone control) for a round - the EW debuff.
  • Mod slots: 1 (deck slot)
  • Tags: Program, Consumable, Wired

Item Tier sets price, Availability, and mod-slot count only — never raw power.
